<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>PICHE UET Peshawar</title>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Poppins:wght@600;700;800&display=swap">
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jspdf/2.5.1/jspdf.umd.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/xlsx/0.18.5/xlsx.full.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/qrcode-generator/1.4.4/qrcode.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.45.4/dist/umd/supabase.min.js"></script>
<style>
:root{--navy:#0B1F45;--green:#168A45;--ink:#252B36;--mut:#5b6b88;--bg:#F4F6F9;--blue:#1769AA;--card:#fff;--line:#d8dfe9;--ok:#1b7f4b;--bad:#b3261e;--warn:#9a6700;--h:#0B1F45;color-scheme:light;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}


html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);font:16px/1.6 Inter,Calibri,Segoe UI,sans-serif}
header{background:var(--card);color:var(--ink);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(11,31,69,.06)}.bar{max-width:1140px;margin:auto;padding:12px 20px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;text-decoration:none}.lp,.lu{display:block;width:auto;background:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:3px}.lp{height:60px}.lu{height:50px}.dv{width:1px;height:40px;background:var(--line)}h1,h2,h3{font-family:Poppins,Inter,Segoe UI,sans-serif}a{color:var(--blue)}.lg{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);display:grid;place-items:center;font-style:normal;overflow:hidden}.lg img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;background:#fff}
nav{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-basis:100%;flex-wrap:wrap;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:8px}nav a{color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;transition:.2s}nav a.on,nav a:hover{background:rgba(23,105,170,.1);color:var(--blue)}nav a.cta,nav a.cta:hover{background:var(--green);color:#fff}
main{max-width:1140px;margin:auto;padding:28px 20px 50px}h1{font-size:clamp(32px,5.5vw,54px);line-height:1.08;margin:0 0 14px}h2{margin:34px 0 12px;font-size:26px;color:var(--h)}h3{color:var(--h);margin:18px 0 6px}main>h2:first-child{margin-top:0}
.hero{color:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:84px 48px;min-height:460px;display:flex;align-items:center;background-size:cover;background-position:center;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(11,31,69,.25)}.hero h1{font-size:clamp(34px,6vw,60px)}.eye{color:#7fe0a6;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:6px}.hero .btn:not(.alt){background:var(--green)}
.hero p{color:#dbe6f7;max-width:54ch;font-size:19px}
.panel{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:20px}.sub{color:var(--mut)}.hint{font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}
.btn{background:var(--blue);transition:.2s;color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:11px 18px;font:700 15px Inter,Calibri,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;display:inline-block}.btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.08)}
.btn.alt{background:transparent;color:var(--blue);border:1.5px solid var(--blue)}.hero .btn.alt{color:#fff;border-color:#fff}.btn.sm{padding:6px 10px;font-size:13px;border-radius:8px}.btn.bad{background:var(--bad)}

.row{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}.g{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:16px}.grid2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:24px;align-items:start}
.pc{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}.pc b{font-size:17px}.pc span{color:var(--green);font-weight:700;font-size:14px}.pc small{color:var(--mut)}
.av{width:84px;height:84px;border-radius:14px;background:#dbe6f5 center/cover;color:var(--navy);display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:800;font-size:28px;margin-bottom:8px}
.ev{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden}.ev img{width:100%;height:150px;object-fit:cover;display:block}.ev div{padding:14px 16px}.ev time{color:var(--green);font-weight:700;font-size:14px}.ev b{display:block}
label{display:block;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;margin:12px 0 4px}label.ck{font-weight:500;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start;grid-column:1/-1}label.ck input{width:auto;margin-top:5px}
input,select,textarea{width:100%;padding:10px 12px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;background:var(--card);color:var(--ink);font:inherit}
:is(input,select,textarea,button,a):focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--green);outline-offset:2px}
.two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0 14px}.wide{grid-column:1/-1}.err{color:var(--bad);font-weight:600;margin-top:10px}
canvas.cardv{width:100%;max-width:520px;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(31,56,100,.28);display:block;margin-bottom:12px}
.badge{padding:2px 10px;border-radius:99px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;border:1.5px solid currentColor;white-space:nowrap}.b-Active,.b-Verified{color:var(--ok)}.b-Pending,.b-Correction{color:var(--warn)}.b-Inactive,.b-Former,.b-Rejected{color:var(--bad)}
.tw{overflow-x:auto}table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;min-width:760px}th,td{text-align:left;padding:9px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:14px;vertical-align:middle}th{color:var(--mut);font-size:13px}td input[type=checkbox]{width:auto}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(130px,1fr));gap:12px}.stats b{font-size:30px;color:var(--h);display:block;line-height:1.1}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:14px 0}.tabs button{border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);color:var(--ink);border-radius:9px;padding:7px 13px;font:600 14px Inter,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.tabs .on{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border-color:var(--navy)}
.filters{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin:12px 0}.filters *{margin:0}
dialog{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:var(--card);color:var(--ink);max-width:600px;width:92%;padding:22px}dialog::backdrop{background:rgba(10,20,45,.55)}
dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:6px 16px;margin:10px 0}dt{color:var(--mut)}dd{margin:0;font-weight:600}
.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:calc(20px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));transform:translateX(-50%);background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:11px 18px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:600;z-index:9;max-width:90%}
footer{background:var(--navy);color:#cfdcf2;padding:26px 20px;font-size:14px}footer div{max-width:1140px;margin:auto;display:flex;gap:24px;flex-wrap:wrap}footer a{color:#fff}
.panel,.pc,.ev{box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(11,31,69,.05),0 8px 22px rgba(11,31,69,.05);transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s}.pc:hover,.ev:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(11,31,69,.12)}.pil{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:16px;margin:26px 0 0}.pil svg{width:34px;height:34px;stroke:var(--green);fill:none;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.pil b{display:block;color:var(--h);font-family:Poppins,Inter,sans-serif}footer img{height:56px}@media (max-width:820px){.hero,.grid2{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hero{padding:48px 24px;min-height:380px}.two{grid-template-columns:1fr}.filters{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}nav{margin-left:0}}
.bt{display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:1.25}.bt b{font:700 17px Poppins,Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--navy)}.bt span{font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}th{text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;font-size:12px;background:#f7f9fc}tbody tr:hover td{background:#f7f9fc}.stats .panel{border-top:4px solid var(--blue)}.stats .panel:nth-child(even){border-top-color:var(--green)}.dh{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:5px solid var(--green);border-radius:14px;padding:16px 20px;margin-bottom:18px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(11,31,69,.05)}.dash{display:grid;grid-template-columns:200px 1fr;gap:20px;align-items:start}.dash .tabs{flex-direction:column;margin:0;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:10px;position:sticky;top:12px}.dash .tabs button{text-align:left;border:0;background:transparent;border-radius:9px;padding:10px 12px}.dash .tabs button:hover{background:var(--bg)}.dash .tabs .on,.dash .tabs .on:hover{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}@media (max-width:820px){.dash{grid-template-columns:1fr}.dash .tabs{flex-direction:row;position:static;overflow-x:auto}.dv,.bu .bt{display:none}.bt b{font-size:15px}}
</style></head><body>
<header><div class="bar"><a class="brand" href="#home" aria-label="PICHE UET Peshawar Chapter home"><img class="lp" alt="PICHE logo"><span class="bt"><b>PICHE</b><span>UET Peshawar Chapter</span></span></a><span class="dv"></span><span class="brand bu"><img class="lu" alt="UET Peshawar logo"><span class="bt"><b>University of Engineering &amp; Technology</b><span>Peshawar</span></span></span><nav id="nav"></nav></div></header>
<main id="app"></main><footer><div id="ft"></div></footer><dialog id="dlg"></dialog><div id="toast" class="toast" hidden></div>
<script>
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s),esc=s=>String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
// Paste your Supabase project values here (Project Settings > API). The anon key is safe to publish; access is limited by the database rules in schema.sql.
const SB_URL='https://rbycnpcbtvwoogbbgavz.supabase.co/rest/v1/',SB_KEY='eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJzdXBhYmFzZSIsInJlZiI6InJieWNucGNidHZ3b29nYmJnYXZ6Iiwicm9sZSI6ImFub24iLCJpYXQiOjE3OTQwMjkzOTksImV4cCI6MjEwOTYwNTM5OX0.Q4Kk0cPgDZXKPG4SvgtivoWP9HnQmEdVgGNTUd2ODuo
';
const IMG={p:'data:image/jpeg;base64,',u:'data:image/png;base64,',h:'data:image/jpeg;base64,'};
const DEPTS=['Chemical Engineering','Petroleum & Natural Gas Engineering','Mining Engineering','Metallurgical Engineering','Polymer & Petrochemical Engineering','Environmental Engineering'],SEMS=[1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8],BG=['A+','A-','B+','B-','O+','O-','AB+','AB-'],ST=['Active','Inactive','Pending','Former','Verified','Rejected','Correction'],PUB=['Active','Inactive','Former','Verified'];
const PW={admin:'admin-demo',cabinet:'cabinet-demo'};// demo only: live site uses Supabase Auth
let db,sess=null,tab='over',sel=new Set(),cap=0;
const today=()=>new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),oneYear=()=>{const d=new Date();d.setFullYear(d.getFullYear()+1);return d.toISOString().slice(0,10)},fmt=v=>v?new Date(v).toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{day:'numeric',month:'short',year:'numeric'}):'—',uid=()=>'u'+Date.now().toString(36)+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6);
const sb=window.supabase.createClient(SB_URL||'https://placeholder.supabase.co',SB_KEY||'placeholder');let snap={},lastLoad=0,busy=Promise.resolve();
const memOf=r=>({t:r.id,n:r.name,f:r.father,r:r.reg_no,e:r.email,d:r.department,s:r.semester,a:r.address,b:r.blood||'',bv:!!r.blood_verified,st:r.status,id:r.membership_id||'',v:r.valid_until||'',pub:r.public_listing,photo:r.photo_url||'',note:r.note||'',roles:r.roles||[]}),
rowOf=m=>({id:m.t,name:m.n,father:m.f,reg_no:m.r,email:m.e,department:m.d,semester:m.s,address:m.a,blood:m.b||null,blood_verified:!!m.bv,status:m.st,membership_id:m.id||null,valid_until:m.v||null,public_listing:m.pub,photo_url:m.photo||null,note:m.note||null}),
EV=x=>({id:x._id,title:x.t,event_date:x.d,venue:x.loc||null,description:x.desc||null,photo_url:x.photo||null}),NW=x=>({id:x._id,title:x.t,news_date:x.d,body:x.body||null});
const snapOf=()=>({m:Object.fromEntries(db.members.map(m=>[m.t,JSON.stringify(rowOf(m))])),r:Object.fromEntries(db.members.map(m=>[m.t,JSON.stringify(m.roles)])),ev:Object.fromEntries(db.events.map(x=>[x._id,JSON.stringify(EV(x))])),nw:Object.fromEntries(db.news.map(x=>[x._id,JSON.stringify(NW(x))])),d:JSON.stringify(db.desigs),s:JSON.stringify([db.cur,db.site])});
async function loadAll(){const g=t=>sb.from(t).select('*'),[ev,nw,ds,st,pm]=await Promise.all([g('events').order('event_date'),g('news').order('news_date'),g('designations').order('sort'),g('settings'),g('public_members')]);
 const S={};(st.data||[]).forEach(x=>S[x.key]=x.value);
 db={cur:S.term||'2026-27',desigs:(ds.data||[]).map(x=>x.name),site:{email:S.email||'',phone:S.phone||'',fb:S.fb||'',ig:S.ig||'',li:S.li||''},events:(ev.data||[]).map(x=>({_id:x.id,t:x.title,d:x.event_date,loc:x.venue||'',desc:x.description||'',photo:x.photo_url||''})),news:(nw.data||[]).map(x=>({_id:x.id,t:x.title,d:x.news_date,body:x.body||''})),members:(pm.data||[]).map(memOf),log:[]};
 if(sess){const[a,b,c]=await Promise.all([sb.from('members').select('*').order('created_at'),g('member_roles'),sess.role==='admin'?sb.from('activity_log').select('*').order('at',{ascending:false}).limit(200):{data:[]}]);
  const full=(a.data||[]).map(r=>memOf({...r,roles:(b.data||[]).filter(x=>x.member_id===r.id).map(x=>({y:x.term,d:x.designation}))}));
  db.members=staff()?full:[...db.members.filter(x=>!full.some(f=>f.t===x.t)),...full];db.log=(c.data||[]).map(x=>({t:new Date(x.at).toLocaleString('en-GB'),u:x.actor,a:x.action}))}
 snap=snapOf();lastLoad=Date.now()}
async function sync(){db.events.concat(db.news).forEach(x=>{if(!x._id)x._id=crypto.randomUUID()});const E=p=>p.then(r=>{if(r.error)throw r.error});
 for(const m of db.members){if(snap.m[m.t]&&snap.m[m.t]!==JSON.stringify(rowOf(m)))await E(sb.from('members').update(rowOf(m)).eq('id',m.t));
  if(staff()&&snap.r[m.t]!==undefined&&snap.r[m.t]!==JSON.stringify(m.roles)){await E(sb.from('member_roles').delete().eq('member_id',m.t));if(m.roles.length)await E(sb.from('member_roles').insert(m.roles.map(r=>({member_id:m.t,term:r.y,designation:r.d}))))}}
 if(staff()){for(const[k,tb,f,o]of[['events','events',EV,snap.ev],['news','news',NW,snap.nw]]){for(const x of db[k])if(o[x._id]!==JSON.stringify(f(x)))await E(sb.from(tb).upsert(f(x)));for(const id in o)if(!db[k].some(x=>x._id===id))await E(sb.from(tb).delete().eq('id',id))}
  if(isA()){if(JSON.stringify(db.desigs)!==snap.d){await E(sb.from('designations').delete().neq('name',''));if(db.desigs.length)await E(sb.from('designations').insert(db.desigs.map((name,sort)=>({name,sort}))))}
   if(JSON.stringify([db.cur,db.site])!==snap.s)await E(sb.from('settings').upsert([{key:'term',value:db.cur},...Object.entries(db.site).map(([key,value])=>({key,value:value||''}))]))}}
 snap=snapOf()}
function save(){busy=busy.then(sync).catch(async e=>{toast('Could not save: '+(e.message||e));try{await loadAll()}catch(_){}});return busy}
async function up(d,path){const b=await(await fetch(d)).blob(),{error}=await sb.storage.from('photos').upload(path+'.jpg',b,{contentType:'image/jpeg'});if(error)throw error;return sb.storage.from('photos').getPublicUrl(path+'.jpg').data.publicUrl}
async function startSession(rg,go){const{data:{user}}=await sb.auth.getUser();if(!user)return;const em=(user.email||'').toLowerCase(),{data:role}=await sb.rpc('my_role');
 if(role==='admin'||role==='cabinet')sess={role,email:em};else{const{data}=await sb.from('members').select('id,reg_no').ilike('email',em),m=(data||[]).find(x=>!rg||x.reg_no.toLowerCase()===rg.toLowerCase());if(!m){await sb.auth.signOut();toast('No member record matches this account.');return}sess={role:'member',t:m.id,email:em}}
 await loadAll();tab='over';nav();if(go){logit('Signed in');location.hash='#portal'}}
function toast(t){const e=$('#toast');e.textContent=t;e.hidden=false;clearTimeout(toast.k);toast.k=setTimeout(()=>e.hidden=true,3200)}
const logit=a=>{db.log.unshift({t:new Date().toLocaleString('en-GB'),u:sess?.role||'',a});sb.from('activity_log').insert({actor:(sess?.role||'')+' '+(sess?.email||''),action:a}).then(()=>{})},isA=()=>sess?.role==='admin',staff=()=>sess&&sess.role!=='member';
const newId=()=>'',desig=m=>(m.roles.find(r=>r.y===db.cur)||{}).d||'',ini=n=>(n||'?').trim().split(/\s+/).map(x=>x[0]).slice(0,2).join('').toUpperCase();
const av=m=>`<div class="av" ${m.photo?`style="background-image:url(${m.photo})"`:''}>${m.photo?'':esc(ini(m.n))}</div>`,badge=s=>`<span class="badge b-${s}">${s}</span>`,page=h=>$('#app').innerHTML=h;
const loadImg=src=>new Promise(r=>{if(!src)return r(null);const i=new Image();i.crossOrigin='anonymous';i.onload=()=>r(i);i.onerror=()=>r(null);i.src=src}),verifyUrl=id=>location.href.split('#')[0]+'#verify-'+id;
async function card(s){
 const W=1012,H=638,cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=W;cv.height=H;const c=cv.getContext('2d'),FF='Inter,Calibri,sans-serif';c.fillStyle='#fff';c.fillRect(0,0,W,H);c.save();c.beginPath();c.roundRect(0,0,W,H,34);c.clip();
 c.fillStyle='#0B1F45';c.fillRect(0,0,W,150);c.fillStyle='#168A45';c.fillRect(0,150,W,8);
 const lo=await loadImg(IMG.p);c.fillStyle='#fff';c.beginPath();c.roundRect(24,12,118,126,14);c.fill();if(lo){const k=Math.min(106/lo.width,114/lo.height);c.drawImage(lo,83-lo.width*k/2,75-lo.height*k/2,lo.width*k,lo.height*k)}
 c.fillStyle='#fff';c.font='800 58px '+FF;c.fillText('PICHE',164,88);c.fillStyle='#bcd3ee';c.font='500 22px '+FF;c.fillText('UET Peshawar Chapter',164,123);c.textAlign='right';c.fillStyle='#8fe0b0';c.font='700 24px '+FF;c.fillText((desig(s)||'MEMBER').toUpperCase(),W-36,88);c.textAlign='left';
 const ph=await loadImg(s.photo);c.save();c.beginPath();c.roundRect(40,185,230,290,16);c.clip();
 if(ph){const k=Math.max(230/ph.width,290/ph.height),w=ph.width*k,h=ph.height*k;c.drawImage(ph,40+(230-w)/2,185+(290-h)/2,w,h)}else{c.fillStyle='#dbe6f5';c.fillRect(40,185,230,290);c.fillStyle='#0B1F45';c.textAlign='center';c.font='800 90px '+FF;c.fillText(ini(s.n),155,352);c.textAlign='left'}
 c.restore();c.strokeStyle='#168A45';c.lineWidth=4;c.beginPath();c.roundRect(40,185,230,290,16);c.stroke();
 let fs=40;c.fillStyle='#252B36';do{c.font='800 '+fs+'px '+FF;fs-=2}while(c.measureText(s.n||'').width>480&&fs>20);c.fillText(s.n||'',305,225);c.fillStyle='#5b6b88';c.font='500 25px '+FF;c.fillText('S/O '+(s.f||'—'),305,260);
 const row=(l,v,x,y)=>{c.fillStyle='#5b6b88';c.font='600 19px '+FF;c.fillText(l,x,y);c.fillStyle='#252B36';c.font='700 27px '+FF;c.fillText(v,x,y+30)};
 row('Registration no.',s.r||'—',305,310);row('Department',(s.d||'—').replace(' Engineering',' Eng.'),305,376);row('Semester',String(s.s||'—'),305,442);row('Blood group',s.bv&&s.b?s.b:'—',520,442);
 const q=qrcode(0,'M');q.addData(verifyUrl(s.id));q.make();const qi=await loadImg(q.createDataURL(8,0));if(qi)c.drawImage(qi,818,190,160,160);c.fillStyle='#5b6b88';c.font='600 18px '+FF;c.textAlign='center';c.fillText('Scan to verify',898,376);c.textAlign='left';
 c.fillStyle='#0B1F45';c.fillRect(0,525,W,113);c.fillStyle='#168A45';c.fillRect(0,525,W,8);c.fillStyle='#fff';c.font='800 40px '+FF;c.fillText(s.id,40,598);c.textAlign='right';c.font='600 24px '+FF;c.fillText('Valid until '+fmt(s.v),W-36,596);c.restore();cv.className='cardv';return cv}
async function pdf(l){const d=new jspdf.jsPDF({orientation:'landscape',unit:'mm',format:[85.6,54]});for(let i=0;i<l.length;i++){if(i)d.addPage([85.6,54],'landscape');d.addImage((await card(l[i])).toDataURL('image/jpeg',.92),'JPEG',0,0,85.6,54)}return d.output('arraybuffer')}
async function saveFile(name,data){try{const dl=window.claude&&await claude.use('downloads');if(!dl)return toast('Downloads are not available in this view.');await dl.save({filename:name,data});toast('Saved '+name)}catch(e){if(e&&e.code!=='declined')toast('Could not save the file.')}}
function resize(file,w=360,h=450){return new Promise((ok,no)=>{if(!file)return ok('');if(!/^image\/(jpeg|png|webp)$/.test(file.type))return no('Photos must be JPG, PNG or WebP.');if(file.size>5e6)return no('Photos must be under 5 MB.');const u=URL.createObjectURL(file),i=new Image();i.onload=()=>{const cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=w;cv.height=h;const x=cv.getContext('2d'),k=Math.max(w/i.width,h/i.height);x.drawImage(i,(w-i.width*k)/2,(h-i.height*k)/2,i.width*k,i.height*k);URL.revokeObjectURL(u);ok(cv.toDataURL('image/jpeg',.85))};i.onerror=()=>no('That file is not a readable image.');i.src=u})}
const MF=[['n','Full name','text'],['f','Father’s name','text'],['r','University registration no.','text'],['e','Email address','email'],['d','Department','select',DEPTS],['s','Current semester','select',SEMS],['b','Blood group (optional)','select',['',...BG]],['a','Residential address','textarea']];
function fld(f,v){const[k,l,t,o]=f;if(t==='checkbox')return`<label class="ck"><input type="checkbox" name="${k}" ${v?'checked':''}>${l}</label>`;
 const i=t==='dl'?`<input name="${k}" list="dl-${k}" value="${esc(v)}" placeholder="Type any designation"><datalist id="dl-${k}">${o.map(x=>`<option value="${esc(x)}">`).join('')}</datalist>`:t==='select'?`<select name="${k}">${o.map(x=>`<option ${String(x)===String(v)?'selected':''} value="${esc(x)}">${esc(x||'None')}</option>`).join('')}</select>`:t==='textarea'?`<textarea name="${k}" rows="3">${esc(v)}</textarea>`:`<input name="${k}" type="${t}" ${t==='file'?'accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp"':`value="${esc(v)}"`} ${k==='e'?'placeholder="name@example.com"':''}>`;return`<div ${/textarea|file/.test(t)?'class="wide"':''}><label>${l}</label>${i}</div>`}
const collect=r=>{const o={};r.querySelectorAll('[name]').forEach(e=>o[e.name]=e.type==='file'?e.files[0]:e.type==='checkbox'?e.checked:e.value.trim());if('s'in o)o.s=+o.s||1;return o};
function ask(title,fs,v,cb){const d=$('#dlg');d.innerHTML=`<h2 style="margin-top:0">${esc(title)}</h2><form id="af"><div class="two">${fs.map(f=>fld(f,v[f[0]])).join('')}</div><div id="e" class="err"></div><div class="row" style="margin-top:14px"><button class="btn">Save</button><button class="btn alt" type="button" id="cx">Cancel</button></div></form>`;d.showModal();$('#cx').onclick=()=>d.close();
 $('#af').onsubmit=async ev=>{ev.preventDefault();try{const m=await cb(collect($('#af')));if(m)return $('#e').textContent=m;d.close()}catch(x){$('#e').textContent=String(x)}}}
function check(o,skip){const nm=/^[A-Za-z .'-]{3,60}$/;if(!nm.test(o.n))return'Enter the full name using letters only.';if(!nm.test(o.f))return'Enter the father’s name using letters only.';if(!/^[A-Za-z0-9\/-]{5,20}$/.test(o.r))return'Registration number should be 5 to 20 letters or digits, for example 24PWCHE1735.';
 if(!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/.test(o.e))return'Enter a valid email address.';if(o.a.length<8)return'Enter the full residential address.';if(db.members.some(x=>x.r&&x.r.toLowerCase()===o.r.toLowerCase()&&x.t!==skip))return'This registration number is already registered.';return''}
const person=m=>`<div class="pc">${av(m)}<b>${esc(m.n)}</b>${desig(m)?`<span>${esc(desig(m))}</span>`:''}<small>${esc(m.d)}, semester ${m.s}</small></div>`;
const evc=e=>`<article class="ev">${e.photo?`<img src="${e.photo}" alt="">`:''}<div><time>${fmt(e.d)}</time><b>${esc(e.t)}</b><span class="sub">${esc(e.loc||'')}</span><p style="margin:6px 0 0">${esc(e.desc||'')}</p></div></article>`;
const nwc=n=>`<div class="panel" style="margin-bottom:12px"><time class="hint">${fmt(n.d)}</time><h3 style="margin:2px 0 4px">${esc(n.t)}</h3><span>${esc(n.body)}</span></div>`;
const order=m=>db.desigs.indexOf(desig(m)),cabinet=()=>db.members.filter(m=>desig(m)).sort((a,b)=>order(a)-order(b)),upc=()=>db.events.filter(e=>e.d>=today()).sort((a,b)=>a.d<b.d?-1:1),news=()=>[...db.news].sort((a,b)=>a.d<b.d?1:-1),pubm=()=>db.members.filter(m=>PUB.includes(m.st)&&m.pub);
const V={};
V.home=()=>{const c=cabinet().slice(0,4);page(`<section class="hero" style="background-image:linear-gradient(100deg,rgba(11,31,69,.95) 0%,rgba(11,31,69,.80) 48%,rgba(23,105,170,.30) 100%),url(${IMG.h})"><div><div class="eye">Learn. Innovate. Excel.</div><h1>PICHE UET Peshawar</h1><p>The student society of chemical engineers at the University of Engineering & Technology, Peshawar. We run workshops, visits and competitions that connect the classroom to the plant floor.</p><div class="row"><a class="btn" href="#register">Join PICHE</a><a class="btn alt" href="#cabinet">Meet the cabinet</a></div></div></section><div class="pil"><div class="panel"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 5h6a3 3 0 0 1 3 3v11a2 2 0 0 0-2-2H4zM20 5h-6a3 3 0 0 0-3 3v11a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h7z"/></svg><b>Learn</b><span class="sub">Workshops, seminars and training beyond the syllabus.</span></div><div class="panel"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M9 18h6M10 21h4M12 3a6 6 0 0 0-4 10.5c.7.7 1 1.5 1 2.5h6c0-1 .3-1.8 1-2.5A6 6 0 0 0 12 3z"/></svg><b>Innovate</b><span class="sub">Technical projects and competitions that test new ideas.</span></div><div class="panel"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M8 21h8M12 17v4M7 4h10v5a5 5 0 0 1-10 0zM17 5h3v2a3 3 0 0 1-3 3M7 5H4v2a3 3 0 0 0 3 3"/></svg><b>Excel</b><span class="sub">Recognition for achievement and a strong professional network.</span></div></div>
<h2>About us</h2><div class="g"><div class="panel"><h3 style="margin-top:0">Mission</h3>We help chemical engineering students build technical skill, professional networks and leadership through activities beyond the syllabus.</div><div class="panel"><h3 style="margin-top:0">Vision</h3>A well-organised student society that prepares confident, responsible engineers for industry and the community.</div></div><p><a href="#about">Read more about PICHE</a></p>
<h2>Executive cabinet</h2><div class="g">${c.map(person).join('')}</div><p><a href="#cabinet">See the full cabinet</a></p>
<h2>Upcoming events</h2><div class="g">${upc().slice(0,3).map(evc).join('')||'<p class="sub">No upcoming events yet. Check back soon.</p>'}</div>
<h2>Latest announcements</h2>${news().slice(0,3).map(nwc).join('')}
<h2>Membership</h2><div class="panel"><p style="margin-top:0">Any registered student can apply. V.about=()=>page(`<h2>About PICHE</h2><div class="panel"><p style="margin-top:0">PICHE UET Peshawar is the student society of the chemical engineering community at the University of Engineering & Technology, Peshawar. It is run by an elected executive cabinet and open to registered students.</p><h3>Vision</h3><p>A well-organised student society that prepares confident, responsible engineers for industry and the community.</p><h3>Mission</h3><p>To support students’ technical, professional and personal growth through learning, collaboration and service.</p><h3>Objectives</h3><ul><li>Organise workshops, seminars and training sessions.</li><li>Arrange industrial visits and connect students with professionals.</li><li>Run technical competitions and student development activities.</li><li>Encourage community engagement and recognise achievements.</li></ul><h3>Organisational structure</h3><p>The cabinet is led by the ${esc(db.desigs[0])} and ${esc(db.desigs[1])}, supported by ${db.desigs.slice(2,8).map(esc).join(', ')}, and executive and general members.</p><h3>Contribution to the university</h3><p>PICHE gives students a place to practise teamwork, organise events and represent the department at university level.</p></div>`);
V.cabinet=()=>{const ys=[...new Set(db.members.flatMap(m=>m.roles.map(r=>r.y)))].filter(y=>y!==db.cur).sort().reverse();page(`<h2>Executive cabinet ${esc(db.cur)}</h2><div class="g">${cabinet().map(person).join('')||'<p class="sub">No cabinet published yet.</p>'}</div>${ys.length?'<h2>Previous cabinets</h2>':''}${ys.map(y=>`<h3>${esc(y)}</h3><div class="g">${db.members.filter(m=>m.roles.some(r=>r.y===y)).map(m=>{const r=m.roles.find(r=>r.y===y);return`<div class="pc">${av(m)}<b>${esc(m.n)}</b><span>${esc(r.d)}</span><small>Tenure ${esc(y)}</small></div>`}).join('')}</div>`).join('')}`)};
V.members=()=>{page(`<h2>Member directory</h2><p class="sub">Only members who agreed to be listed appear here, and only with public details.</p><div class="filters"><input id="q" placeholder="Search name or membership no." aria-label="Search"><select id="fd" aria-label="Department"><option value="">All departments</option>${DEPTS.map(x=>`<option>${esc(x)}</option>`).join('')}</select><select id="fg" aria-label="Designation"><option value="">Any designation</option>${db.desigs.map(x=>`<option>${esc(x)}</option>`).join('')}</select><select id="ft" aria-label="Status"><option value="">Any status</option>${PUB.map(x=>`<option>${x}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="g" id="ml"></div>`);
 const f=()=>{const q=$('#q').value.toLowerCase(),d=$('#fd').value,g=$('#fg').value,t=$('#ft').value,l=pubm().filter(m=>(!q||m.n.toLowerCase().includes(q)||m.id.toLowerCase().includes(q))&&(!d||m.d===d)&&(!g||desig(m)===g)&&(!t||m.st===t));
  $('#ml').innerHTML=l.map(m=>`<div class="pc">${av(m)}<b>${esc(m.n)}</b>${desig(m)?`<span>${esc(desig(m))}</span>`:''}<small>${esc(m.id)}</small><small>${esc(m.d)}, semester ${m.s}</small><div style="margin-top:6px">${badge(m.st)}</div></div>`).join('')||'<p class="sub">No members match these filters.</p>'};['q','fd','fg','ft'].forEach(i=>$('#'+i).oninput=f);f()};
V.events=()=>page(`<h2>Events and activities</h2><h3>Upcoming</h3><div class="g">${upc().map(evc).join('')||'<p class="sub">No upcoming events.</p>'}</div><h3>Past events and achievements</h3><div class="g">${db.events.filter(e=>e.d<today()).sort((a,b)=>a.d<b.d?1:-1).map(evc).join('')||'<p class="sub">Nothing yet.</p>'}</div>`);
V.news=()=>page(`<h2>News and announcements</h2>${news().map(nwc).join('')||'<p class="sub">No announcements yet.</p>'}`);
V.register=()=>{page(`<h2>Join PICHE</h2><div class="panel" style="max-width:780px"><form id="rf"><div class="two">${MF.map(f=>fld(f,f[0]==='s'?1:'')).join('')}${fld(['ph','Photograph (passport style, up to 5 MB)','file'])}${fld(['pub','Show my name and photo in the public member directory','checkbox'],true)}${fld(['cons','I consent to PICHE storing my details for membership records','checkbox'])}</div><div id="e" class="err"></div><button class="btn" style="margin-top:14px">Submit application</button></form></div>`);
 $('#rf').onsubmit=async e=>{e.preventDefault();const o=collect($('#rf')),m=check(o),E=x=>$('#e').textContent=x;if(m)return E(m);if(!o.ph)return E('Upload your photograph to continue.');if(!o.cons)return E('Please tick the consent box to continue.');let photo;try{photo=await resize(o.ph)}catch(x){return E(x)}
  const id=crypto.randomUUID();let url;try{url=await up(photo,'reg/'+id)}catch(x){return E('Photo upload failed: '+(x.message||x))}const{error}=await sb.from('members').insert({id,name:o.n,father:o.f,reg_no:o.r,email:o.e.toLowerCase(),department:o.d,semester:o.s,address:o.a,blood:o.b||null,public_listing:o.pub,photo_url:url});if(error)return E(error.code==='23505'?'This registration number is already registered.':'Could not submit: '+error.message);page(`<div class="panel" style="max-width:620px"><h2 style="margin-top:0">Application submitted</h2><p>Your application is pending review. Once approved you can sign in to the portal with your registration number <b>${esc(o.r)}</b> and email address to see your membership and ID card.</p><a class="btn" href="#login">Go to portal</a></div>`)}};
V.login=()=>{if(sess)return location.hash='#portal';page(`<h2>Portal sign in</h2><div class="panel" style="max-width:460px"><form id="lf"><label>Sign in as</label><select id="ro"><option value="member">Registered member</option><option value="staff">Administrator or cabinet</option></select><div id="mf"><label>Registration number</label><input id="r"></div><label>Email address</label><input id="p" type="email" autocomplete="email"><div id="cf" hidden><label>Code sent to your email</label><input id="cd" inputmode="numeric" maxlength="8" autocomplete="one-time-code"></div><div id="e" class="err"></div><button class="btn" style="margin-top:14px" id="go">Send code</button><p class="hint">No password needed. We email you a one-time code.</p></form></div>`);
 $('#ro').onchange=()=>$('#mf').hidden=$('#ro').value!=='member';let sent=false;
 $('#lf').onsubmit=async e=>{e.preventDefault();const E=x=>$('#e').textContent=x,em=$('#p').value.trim().toLowerCase(),mem=$('#ro').value==='member',rg=$('#r').value.trim();E('');if(!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/.test(em))return E('Enter a valid email address.');if(mem&&!rg)return E('Enter your registration number.');
  if(!sent){const{data}=await sb.rpc('can_sign_in',{p_email:em,p_reg:mem?rg:null});if(!data)return E(mem?'No member matches that registration number and email.':'This email is not registered as PICHE staff.');const{error}=await sb.auth.signInWithOtp({email:em,options:{shouldCreateUser:true}});if(error)return E(error.message);sent=true;$('#cf').hidden=false;$('#go').textContent='Verify and sign in';return toast('Code sent. Check your email.')}
  const{error}=await sb.auth.verifyOtp({email:em,token:$('#cd').value.trim(),type:'email'});if(error)return E('That code is not valid or has expired.');await startSession(mem?rg:null,true)}};
V.portal=()=>{if(!sess)return location.hash='#login';sess.role==='member'?memberDash():adminDash()};
V.verify=async id=>{const{data:vd}=await sb.rpc('verify_member',{p_id:id}),v0=vd&&vd[0],m=v0?{n:v0.name,id:v0.membership_id,d:v0.department,st:v0.status,v:v0.valid_until||'',roles:v0.designation?[{y:db.cur,d:v0.designation}]:[]}:null;let h;if(!m)h=`<h2 style="margin-top:0">Membership not found</h2><p>No PICHE membership matches “${esc(id)}”. The card may be invalid.</p>`;else{const live=['Active','Verified'].includes(m.st)&&m.v>=today(),s=live?m.st:(m.st==='Active'||m.st==='Verified'?'Expired':m.st);
 h=`<h2 style="margin-top:0">${live?'Valid PICHE member':'Membership not valid'} ${badge(live?'Active':'Inactive')}</h2><dl><dt>Name</dt><dd>${esc(m.n)}</dd><dt>Membership no.</dt><dd>${esc(m.id)}</dd><dt>Department</dt><dd>${esc(m.d)}</dd><dt>Designation</dt><dd>${esc(desig(m)||'None')}</dd><dt>Status</dt><dd>${esc(s)}</dd><dt>Valid until</dt><dd>${fmt(m.v)}</dd></dl><p class="hint">Only basic membership details are shown. Private information is never displayed.</p>`}page(`<div class="panel" style="max-width:580px">${h}</div>`)};
async function memberDash(){const m=db.members.find(x=>x.t===sess.t);if(!m){sess=null;return location.hash='#login'}const ok=['Active','Verified'].includes(m.st);
 page(`<div class="row"><h2 style="margin:0">Welcome, ${esc(m.n)}</h2>${badge(m.st)}<button class="btn sm alt" data-a="out" style="margin-left:auto">Sign out</button></div><div class="grid2" style="margin-top:16px"><div class="panel"><dl><dt>Membership no.</dt><dd>${esc(m.id||'Assigned on approval')}</dd><dt>Registration no.</dt><dd>${esc(m.r)}</dd><dt>Department</dt><dd>${esc(m.d)}, semester ${m.s}</dd><dt>Designation</dt><dd>${esc(desig(m)||'None')}</dd><dt>Committee history</dt><dd>${esc(m.roles.map(r=>r.y+' '+r.d).join(', ')||'None yet')}</dd><dt>Valid until</dt><dd>${fmt(m.v)}</dd></dl>${m.note?`<p class="err">Correction requested: ${esc(m.note)}</p>`:''}
 <h3>Update your details</h3><form id="uf"><div class="two">${[MF[6],MF[7]].map(f=>fld(f,m[f[0]])).join('')}${fld(['ph','New photograph','file'])}</div><div id="e" class="err"></div><div class="row" style="margin-top:10px"><button class="btn sm">Save changes</button>${m.st==='Correction'?'<button type="button" class="btn sm alt" id="rs">Resubmit for review</button>':''}</div></form><p class="hint">Designation, status and approval are managed by the PICHE administration.</p></div><div><div id="pv">${ok?'':'<div class="panel">Your ID card appears here once your membership is approved.</div>'}</div>${ok?'<button class="btn" id="dl">Download ID card (PDF)</button>':''}<h3>Announcements</h3>${news().slice(0,3).map(nwc).join('')}</div></div>`);
 if(ok){$('#pv').append(await card(m));$('#dl').onclick=async()=>saveFile(m.id+'.pdf',await pdf([m]))}
 $('#uf').onsubmit=async e=>{e.preventDefault();const o=collect($('#uf'));if(o.a.length<8)return $('#e').textContent='Enter your full residential address.';try{if(o.ph)m.photo=await up(await resize(o.ph),'m/'+m.t+'-'+Date.now())}catch(x){return $('#e').textContent=x}m.bv=m.bv&&m.b===o.b;m.b=o.b;m.a=o.a;save();toast('Details updated');memberDash()};
 $('#rs')&&($('#rs').onclick=()=>{m.st='Pending';m.note='';save();toast('Resubmitted for review');memberDash()})}
function adminDash(){const T=[['over','Overview'],['mem','Members'],['ev','Events'],['nws','News'],...(isA()?[['des','Designations'],['log','Activity log'],['set','Site settings']]:[])];
 page(`<div class="dh"><div><h2 style="margin:0">${isA()?'Administrator':'Executive cabinet'} dashboard</h2><span class="hint">PICHE UET Peshawar, cabinet term ${esc(db.cur)}</span></div><button class="btn sm alt" data-a="out">Sign out</button></div><div class="dash"><div class="tabs">${T.map(([k,l])=>`<button class="${k===tab?'on':''}" data-tab="${k}">${l}</button>`).join('')}</div><div id="tc"></div></div>`);TB[tab]()}
const cnt=s=>db.members.filter(m=>m.st===s).length,refresh=async()=>{await save();await loadAll();if(!$('#tc'))return;if(tab==='mem')rows();else adminDash()};
const mact=m=>[['Pending','Correction','Rejected','Inactive'].includes(m.st)?`<button class="btn sm" data-a="ok" data-t="${m.t}">${m.st==='Inactive'?'Reactivate':'Approve'}</button>`:'',m.st==='Pending'?`<button class="btn sm bad" data-a="no" data-t="${m.t}">Reject</button><button class="btn sm alt" data-a="fix" data-t="${m.t}">Corrections</button>`:'',isA()&&['Active','Verified'].includes(m.st)?`<button class="btn sm bad" data-a="off" data-t="${m.t}">Deactivate</button>`:'',`<button class="btn sm alt" data-a="ed" data-t="${m.t}">Edit</button>`,m.id?`<button class="btn sm alt" data-a="card" data-t="${m.t}">Card</button>`:''].join('');
const TB={over(){$('#tc').innerHTML=`<div class="stats"><div class="panel"><b>${db.members.length}</b>Total members</div><div class="panel"><b>${cnt('Active')+cnt('Verified')}</b>Active</div><div class="panel"><b>${cnt('Inactive')}</b>Inactive</div><div class="panel"><b>${cnt('Pending')+cnt('Correction')}</b>Pending applications</div><div class="panel"><b>${cabinet().length}</b>Cabinet ${esc(db.cur)}</div></div><h3>Pending applications</h3><div class="panel tw"><table><tbody>${db.members.filter(m=>m.st==='Pending').map(m=>`<tr><td>${esc(m.n)}</td><td>${esc(m.r)}</td><td>${esc(m.d)}</td><td class="row">${mact(m)}</td></tr>`).join('')||'<tr><td>No pending applications.</td></tr>'}</tbody></table></div>`},
 mem(){$('#tc').innerHTML=`<div class="filters"><input id="q" placeholder="Search name or reg. no." aria-label="Search"><select id="fd" aria-label="Department"><option value="">All departments</option>${DEPTS.map(x=>`<option>${esc(x)}</option>`).join('')}</select><select id="fs" aria-label="Semester"><option value="">Any semester</option>${SEMS.map(x=>`<option>${x}</option>`).join('')}</select><select id="ft" aria-label="Status"><option value="">Any status</option>${ST.map(x=>`<option>${x}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="row" style="margin-bottom:12px"><button class="btn sm" data-a="bulkok">Approve selected</button><button class="btn sm" data-a="bulkpdf">Cards for selected (PDF)</button><button class="btn sm alt" data-a="xlsx">Export to Excel</button></div><div class="panel tw" id="tb"></div>`;['q','fd','fs','ft'].forEach(i=>$('#'+i).oninput=rows);rows()},
 ev:()=>coll('events',EVF,'event'),nws:()=>coll('news',NWF,'announcement'),
 des(){$('#tc').innerHTML=`<div class="row"><button class="btn sm" data-a="dadd">Add designation</button><button class="btn sm alt" data-a="term">Start new cabinet term</button><span class="hint">Current term: ${esc(db.cur)}. Earlier terms stay on the Cabinet page.</span></div><div class="panel tw" style="margin-top:12px"><table><tbody>${db.desigs.map((d,i)=>`<tr><td>${esc(d)}</td><td>${db.members.filter(m=>m.roles.some(r=>r.d===d)).length} holders</td><td class="row"><button class="btn sm alt" data-a="dren" data-i="${i}">Rename</button><button class="btn sm bad" data-a="ddel" data-i="${i}">Delete</button></td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div>`},
 log(){$('#tc').innerHTML=`<div class="panel tw"><table><tbody>${db.log.map(l=>`<tr><td>${esc(l.t)}</td><td>${esc(l.u)}</td><td>${esc(l.a)}</td></tr>`).join('')||'<tr><td>No activity yet.</td></tr>'}</tbody></table></div>`},
 set(){const s=db.site;$('#tc').innerHTML=`<div class="panel"><dl><dt>Email</dt><dd>${esc(s.email||'—')}</dd><dt>Phone</dt><dd>${esc(s.phone||'—')}</dd><dt>Facebook</dt><dd>${esc(s.fb||'—')}</dd><dt>Instagram</dt><dd>${esc(s.ig||'—')}</dd><dt>LinkedIn</dt><dd>${esc(s.li||'—')}</dd></dl><button class="btn sm" data-a="site">Edit contact details</button></div>`}};
const EVF=[['t','Title','text'],['d','Date','date'],['loc','Venue','text'],['desc','Description','textarea'],['ph','Photograph (optional)','file']],NWF=[['t','Headline','text'],['d','Date','date'],['body','Announcement','textarea']];
function coll(k,fs,label){$('#tc').innerHTML=`<button class="btn sm" data-a="add" data-k="${k}">Add ${label}</button><div class="panel tw" style="margin-top:12px"><table><tbody>${db[k].map((x,i)=>`<tr><td>${fmt(x.d)}</td><td>${esc(x.t)}</td><td class="row"><button class="btn sm alt" data-a="edit" data-k="${k}" data-i="${i}">Edit</button><button class="btn sm bad" data-a="del" data-k="${k}" data-i="${i}">Delete</button></td></tr>`).join('')||'<tr><td>Nothing yet.</td></tr>'}</tbody></table></div>`}
const list=()=>{const q=($('#q')?.value||'').toLowerCase(),d=$('#fd')?.value||'',s=$('#fs')?.value||'',t=$('#ft')?.value||'';return db.members.filter(m=>(!q||m.n.toLowerCase().includes(q)||m.r.toLowerCase().includes(q))&&(!d||m.d===d)&&(!s||m.s==+s)&&(!t||m.st===t))};
function rows(){const l=list();$('#tb').innerHTML=l.length?`<table><thead><tr><th></th><th>Name</th><th>Reg. no.</th><th>Department</th><th>Sem</th><th>Designation</th><th>Status</th><th>Actions</th></tr></thead><tbody>${l.map(m=>`<tr><td><input type="checkbox" data-s="${m.t}" ${sel.has(m.t)?'checked':''} aria-label="Select ${esc(m.n)}"></td><td>${esc(m.n)}</td><td>${esc(m.r)}</td><td>${esc(m.d)}</td><td>${m.s}</td><td>${esc(desig(m))}</td><td>${badge(m.st)}</td><td class="row">${mact(m)}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>`:'<p class="hint">No members match these filters.</p>'}
const approve=m=>{m.st=m.st==='Verified'?'Verified':'Active';m.id=m.id||newId();m.v=m.v&&m.v>=today()?m.v:oneYear();m.note='';logit('Approved '+m.n+' ('+m.id+')')};
function editMember(m){const fs=[...MF,['v','Valid until','date'],...(isA()?[['st','Status','select',ST],['dg','Designation this term (choose or type any title)','dl',db.desigs],['bv','Blood group verified','checkbox']]:[])];
 ask('Edit '+m.n,fs,{...m,dg:desig(m)},o=>{const e=check(o,m.t);if(e)return e;Object.assign(m,{n:o.n,f:o.f,r:o.r,e:o.e,d:o.d,s:o.s,a:o.a,b:o.b,v:o.v});if(isA()){m.st=o.st;m.bv=o.bv;m.roles=m.roles.filter(r=>r.y!==db.cur);if(o.dg){if(!db.desigs.includes(o.dg))db.desigs.push(o.dg);m.roles.push({y:db.cur,d:o.dg})}if(['Active','Verified'].includes(m.st)&&!m.id)m.id=newId()}logit('Edited '+m.n);refresh();toast('Changes saved')})}
document.addEventListener('change',e=>{if(e.target.dataset.s){e.target.checked?sel.add(e.target.dataset.s):sel.delete(e.target.dataset.s)}});
document.addEventListener('click',async e=>{const tb=e.target.closest('[data-tab]');if(tb){tab=tb.dataset.tab;return adminDash()}const b=e.target.closest('[data-a]');if(!b)return;const a=b.dataset.a,D=b.dataset,m=db.members.find(x=>x.t===D.t),S=db.members.filter(x=>sel.has(x.t));
 if(a==='out'){logit&&sess&&sess.role!=='member'&&(logit('Signed out'),save());await sb.auth.signOut();sess=null;await loadAll();nav();return location.hash='#home'}
 if(a==='ok')approve(m);else if(a==='no'){m.st='Rejected';logit('Rejected '+m.n)}else if(a==='off'){if(!confirm('Deactivate this membership?'))return;m.st='Inactive';logit('Deactivated '+m.n)}
 else if(a==='fix')return ask('Request corrections from '+m.n,[['note','What needs correcting?','textarea']],{},o=>{if(!o.note)return'Describe what to correct.';m.st='Correction';m.note=o.note;logit('Requested corrections from '+m.n);refresh()});
 else if(a==='ed')return editMember(m);else if(a==='card')return saveFile(m.id+'.pdf',await pdf([m]));
 else if(a==='bulkok'){if(!S.length)return toast('Select at least one member.');S.filter(x=>['Pending','Correction'].includes(x.st)).forEach(approve)}
 else if(a==='bulkpdf'){const l=S.filter(x=>x.id&&['Active','Verified'].includes(x.st));if(!l.length)return toast('Select approved members to print cards.');toast('Generating '+l.length+' cards…');return saveFile('PICHE-cards.pdf',await pdf(l))}
 else if(a==='xlsx'){const ws=XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(list().map(x=>({'Membership ID':x.id,Name:x.n,'Father’s name':x.f,'Reg. no.':x.r,Email:x.e,Department:x.d,Semester:x.s,'Blood group':x.b,Address:x.a,Status:x.st,Designation:desig(x),'Valid until':x.v}))),wb=XLSX.utils.book_new();XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb,ws,'Members');logit('Exported member records');save();return saveFile('PICHE-members.xlsx',XLSX.write(wb,{bookType:'xlsx',type:'array'}))}
 else if(a==='add'||a==='edit'){const k=D.k,fs=k==='events'?EVF:NWF,x=a==='edit'?db[k][+D.i]:{d:today()};return ask((a==='edit'?'Edit ':'Add ')+(k==='events'?'event':'announcement'),fs,x,async o=>{if(!o.t||!o.d)return'Title and date are required.';const ph=o.ph?await up(await resize(o.ph,600,340),'ev/'+crypto.randomUUID()):x.photo;delete o.ph;const n={...x,...o};if(ph)n.photo=ph;a==='edit'?db[k][+D.i]=n:db[k].push(n);logit((a==='edit'?'Edited ':'Added ')+k+': '+o.t);refresh()})}
 else if(a==='del'){if(!confirm('Delete this item?'))return;logit('Deleted '+D.k+': '+db[D.k][+D.i].t);db[D.k].splice(+D.i,1)}
 else if(a==='dadd')return ask('Add designation',[['d','Designation name','text']],{},o=>{if(!o.d)return'Enter a name.';db.desigs.push(o.d);logit('Added designation '+o.d);refresh()});
 else if(a==='dren'){const old=db.desigs[+D.i];return ask('Rename designation',[['d','Designation name','text']],{d:old},o=>{if(!o.d)return'Enter a name.';db.desigs[+D.i]=o.d;db.members.forEach(m=>m.roles.forEach(r=>{if(r.d===old)r.d=o.d}));logit('Renamed designation '+old+' to '+o.d);refresh()})}
 else if(a==='ddel'){const d=db.desigs[+D.i];if(db.members.some(m=>m.roles.some(r=>r.d===d)))return toast('This designation has holders. Rename it instead to keep records.');db.desigs.splice(+D.i,1);logit('Deleted designation '+d)}
 else if(a==='term')return ask('Start new cabinet term',[['y','Term (for example 2027-28)','text']],{},o=>{if(!/^\d{4}-\d{2}$/.test(o.y))return'Use the format 2027-28.';if(o.y===db.cur)return'That term is already current.';logit('Cabinet term changed from '+db.cur+' to '+o.y);db.cur=o.y;refresh()});
 else if(a==='site')return ask('Contact details',[['email','Email','text'],['phone','Phone','text'],['fb','Facebook link','text'],['ig','Instagram link','text'],['li','LinkedIn link','text'],],db.site,async o=>{db.site={...db.site,...o};logit('Updated site settings');save();nav();adminDash()});
 refresh()});
function nav(){const l=[['home','Home'],['about','About'],['cabinet','Cabinet'],['members','Members'],['events','Events'],['news','News']];$('#nav').innerHTML=l.map(([k,t])=>`<a href="#${k}" data-r="${k}">${t}</a>`).join('')+`<a class="cta" href="#register" data-r="register">Join</a><a href="#portal" data-r="portal">${sess?'Dashboard':'Portal'}</a>`;
 document.querySelectorAll('.lp').forEach(i=>i.src=IMG.p);document.querySelectorAll('.lu').forEach(i=>i.src=IMG.u);const s=db.site,lk=(u,t)=>/^https?:\/\//.test(u)?`<a href="${esc(u)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${t}</a>`:'';
 $('#ft').innerHTML=`<span class="row"><img class="lp" src="${IMG.p}" alt="PICHE"><img class="lu" src="${IMG.u}" alt="UET Peshawar"></span><span><b>PICHE UET Peshawar</b><br>University of Engineering & Technology, Peshawar</span><span>${s.email?esc(s.email)+'<br>':''}${esc(s.phone)}${!s.email&&!s.phone?'Contact details are added by the administrator.':''}</span><span>${[lk(s.fb,'Facebook'),lk(s.ig,'Instagram'),lk(s.li,'LinkedIn')].filter(Boolean).join(' &nbsp; ')}</span>`}
async function route(){if(Date.now()-lastLoad>20000){try{await loadAll()}catch(e){toast('Could not load data. Check your connection.')}}const h=location.hash.slice(1)||'home';nav();document.querySelectorAll('#nav a').forEach(a=>a.classList.toggle('on',a.dataset.r===h.split('-')[0]));if(h.startsWith('verify-'))V.verify(h.slice(7));else(V[h]||V.home)();window.scrollTo(0,0)}
(async()=>{if(!SB_URL||!SB_KEY){$('#app').innerHTML='<div class="panel" style="max-width:640px"><h2 style="margin-top:0">Setup needed</h2><p>Add your Supabase project URL and anon key at the top of this file (SB_URL and SB_KEY), then reload. See README.md.</p></div>';return}
 try{const{data:{session}}=await sb.auth.getSession();if(session)await startSession(null,false);if(!sess)await loadAll()}catch(e){toast('Could not connect to the database.')}
 window.addEventListener('hashchange',route);route()})();
</script></body></html>
